verdict.rationale: Postman documents its own Postman API for programmatically managing Postman assets and integrating with toolchains, plus an Analytics API for reports, so a meaningful share of UI functionality is reachable programmatically. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows parity with the UI, and many UI features (live sessions, comments, Agent Mode, visual workflow building) have no documented API equivalent. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API–UI feature parity, API coverage evidence for collaboration features (live sessions, comments, roles), independent or hands-on corroboration of breadth.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Use the Postman API to programmatically manage your Postman assets and integrate Postman into your development toolchain.
The Analytics API enables you to explore Postman’s analytics reports programmatically.
Use collections, Spec Hub, and the Postman API to design your API in Postman.
